messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin"
set: ["take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "if child vomits within 30 minutes after taking, take another dose", "take at least 30 minutes before first food, beverage, or other oral medications of the day", "15 to 30 minutes", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "do not take after 30 weeks of pregnancy", "may eat, drink, or take other oral medicines after 30 minutes of taking the tablet"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
